en: O Lord of the World,
at the beginning of the aeon, who indeed could exist before me?
O you whose nature is compassion, the essence of all things, you whose form is the universe!
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to you, the Preliminary Stage (samantaka), who bows even before the task at hand; I prostrate at your pair of feet. || 1 ||
O gentle one, returning day after day with your entire form, you appear like a brilliant chariot made of pure gold, free from the dust of darkness.
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to your pair of feet. || 2 ||
You alone are indeed that Brahmā renowned in the community of Brahmins;
you are Viṣṇu in the Vaiṣṇava doctrine, the banner of supreme dharma;
you are the omniscient one, the source of all, and the imperishable.
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to the pair of your feet. || 3 ||
In the lineage of the Buddha, you become Vajrakasūryarūpa,
a Lord of Yoga indeed upon the paths of auspicious yoga;
you are Gaṅgādhara, the destroyer of the fear of worldly existence.
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to your pair of feet. || 4 ||

O Lord of Compassion, you are the teacher of the world; your heart is the very essence of compassion, you are innate splendor, you have severed the accumulation of all impurities, and you are an ocean of virtues— you are the wish-fulfilling gem.
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to your pair of feet. || 5 ||
O you of the color of the bandhūka flower, many-formed, large-eyed,
who have performed atonement for all births,
with beautiful teeth; you are Padmapāṇi, the most pure and supreme, in the form of a friend.
O Śrī Lokanātha, I bow to your pair of feet.
Who is capable of recounting your manifold deeds?
Nevertheless, I praise you here with words of eloquence;
even though this [praise] is entirely flawed, please forgive it all.
"Praise" refers to a garland of flowers; "worship" consists of mere devotion. || 7 ||
The hymn of praise to the venerable Lord Śrīmad Āryāvalokiteśvara is completed.
